facts.what: 开门见 Finlay：灰连帽衫、浅蓝牛仔裤、白球鞋；高她很多，像六英尺出头
facts.anchor: He must be a good three inches over six-foot, and he towers over my 5’2” stature like a guardian angel.

facts.what: 屏息放松连五秒都做不到，骂自己可悲；只穿旧灰T恤与有破洞的打底裤
facts.anchor: I can’t even reach five seconds. Pathetic.

facts.what: 清嗓但不正式问好；说“Eh, hi. You all right?”；自行走进门
facts.anchor: ‘Eh, hi. You all right?’ He finally speaks

facts.what: 低头发现裤脚还塞在白色毛绒睡袜里
facts.anchor: still firmly tucked into fluffy white pyjama socks

facts.what: 把耳内尖鸣当作确有天赋的征兆
facts.anchor: haven’t I been experiencing an influx of signs? The ones that suggest I might actually be gifted.

facts.what: 肚子警告她谨慎，心跳却压倒警觉
facts.anchor: Strangely, my guts are churning, warning me to be cautious – but my heart is much more powerful, dominating.

facts.what: 无视她的座位指示，自行坐到窗边椅；椅脚刮木地板
facts.anchor: ‘Do you mind?’ he asks, completely disregarding my instruction as he bounds toward the window.
